items.source: Note that the value doesn't need to be the final required type: A BeanWrapper implementation should handle any necessary conversion, as this object doesn't know anything about the objects it will be applied to.
items.translation: 注意，该值不必是最终所需的类型： `BeanWrapper` 实现应处理任何必要的转换，因为此对象对其将要应用的对象一无所知。

items.source: Note that type conversion will not have occurred here. It is the responsibility of the BeanWrapper implementation to perform type conversion.
items.translation: 请注意，此处并未发生类型转换。执行类型转换的责任在于 BeanWrapper 实现。
